$comment: Approximate seconds each real-binary acceptance spec file takes in CI, used only to balance the Colab acceptance shards (typescript/scripts/colab-acceptance-shards.mjs).
A stale or missing weight costs balance, never coverage: every spec file always lands in exactly one shard (guarded by typescript/test/tooling/colab-acceptance-shards.test.ts).

Whole seconds rounded up from passed-test duration sums in PR run 40812698080 (2026-10-29, #5516 head fedcb56b1d81cdc106717e7d971b0bb6d52f2741, both shards), where page-compaction.spec.ts carries the 2 MiB case at its #5511 cost. Its shard 1 stopped at the deadline before page-save-large.spec.ts and titles.spec.ts ran; those two come from run 40806552100 (#5516 head 6a47b04ec4b58901de413f148796f623297ecd35). Outcomes matched to list-reporter file/location/title because the public outcomes omit file IDs.

This is one observed run per file, not a stable estimate or a measured improvement. Earlier weights used green main runs 39240809828 (2026-10-19), 38218284566 and 38222074650 (2026-10-12), with up to 1.6x per-file variance; the 2026-10-29 run took about 1.2x the 2026-10-19 sums. Refit after coverage changes; defaultSeconds applies to new files. Shard 1 also runs a separate hosted-reader proof (about 190 seconds in run 40812698080), outside these suite weights.
